texts.preamble: Soundharya vs The Proprietor, Standard Information ... on 22 April, 2025 Kabc020257992022 Before The Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bangalore. (Scch-9) Dated This The 22nd Day Of April 2025 Present Smt.Nirmala.M.C.,B.Com.,L.L.B ., Judge, Court Of Small Causes & Acjm M.V.C No.4726/2022 c/w M.V.C No.4727/2022 Petitioner in : 1. Sri. Soundharya, Mvc.4726/2022 W/o. Late. Muniraju.
texts.facts: The claim petition in MVC.No.4727/2022 has filed by the petitioner u/s.166 of Motor Vehicle Act, claiming compensation of Rs.15,00,000/- with interest from the date of petition till its realization for injuries sustained by him in a Road Traffic Accident. 2 Hence, these 2 petitions were clubbed together for the purpose of recording common evidence. The MVC No. 4727/2022 is clubbed with main petition MVC No.4726/2022. 2. The brief facts in MVC No.4726/2022 and MVC No.4727/2022 are as under:- It is submitted that on 05.08.2022 at about 3.40 pm., in MVC No.4726/2022, when Muniraju (herein onwards referred as deceased) was riding the motor cycle bearing reg.No.KA-05- (SCCH-9) MVC.No.4726/2022 4 c/w MVC.No.4727/2022 JP-3031 along with petitioner in MVC No.4727/2022 as pillion rider slowly, carefully by observing traffic rules and when deceased Muniraju/rider was heading from Jigani Industrial Area towards Kalubalu cross towards Tata Advance Company at that time, one Eicher Canter bearing reg.No.TS-08-UG-6324 came towards Tata Advance Company from Vadera Manchanahalli side with rash and negligent manner and dashed to the deceased's motor cycle. Due to said impact, the deceased in MVC No.4726/2022 and petitioner in MVC No.4727/2022 fell down and sustained multiple injuries. Immediately after the accident, both were shifted to Vijayashree Hospital, Jigani, Bangalore and on medical advice they were shifted to Sparsh Hospital, Bangalore wherein they spent huge amount towards medical expenses and conveyance etc., In MVC No.4726/2022, deceased Muniraju was working in a Petrol bunk and earning a sum of Rs.25,000/- per month. wherein petitioner in MVC No.4727/2022 working as Driver and earning a sum of Rs.30,000/- per month. (SCCH-9) MVC.No.4726/2022 5 c/w MVC.No.4727/2022 The accident occurred solely due to rash and negligent driving of the driver of Eicher Canter bearing reg.No.TS-08- UG-6324. The Jigani police have registered a case against the driver of said vehicle in crime No.0140/2022 u/s.279, 337 of IPC. The respondent No.1 is the Owner and the respondent No.2 is the insurer of Eicher Canter bearing reg.No.TS-08-UG- 6324 and the insurance policy was in force. Hence both respondents are jointly and severally liable to pay the compensation in said both cases. Hence these petitions. 3. After service of notice in both the petitions, the respondent No.1 remained absent and placed exparte. Respondent No.2 appeared through its advocate and filed its written statement. The brief contents of written statement of respondent No.2 is that, the claim petition is not maintainable in law or on facts of the same. It has admitted that, it is the insurer of Lorry bearing reg.No.TS-08-UG-6324 and liability to indemnify the 1st respondent is subject to the terms and conditions of the policy, provisions of the MV Act, valid and effective driving (SCCH-9) MVC.No.4726/2022 6 c/w MVC.No.4727/2022 licence held by the driver of said Lorry. It has also contended that the owner of the alleged offending vehicle and the concerned police have not complied the mandatory provisions Soundharya vs The Proprietor, Standard Information ... on 22 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121957299/ 4 of Sec.134(c) and 158(6) of MV Act. Further it has contended that, the driver of the vehicle has no valid and effective driving licence at the time of accident. Further contended that, the Lorry bearing reg.No.TS-08-UG-6324 was used in a public place without having a valid permit is a clear violation of the terms and conditions of the insurance policy. It has denied the age, income and avocation of the deceased Muniraju and petitioner. With these grounds the respondent No.2 sought for rejecting the claim petition in both the cases. ISSUES IN MVC.4727/2022 1. Whether the petitioners prove that on 05.08.2022 at about 3.40 pm., while petitioner was proceeding as a pillion rider on motor cycle bearing No.KA-05-JP-3031 from Jigani Industrial Area towards Kalubalu Cross towards Tata Advance Company, at that time the driver of Eicher Canter bearing reg.No.TS- 08-UG-6324 came towards Tata Advance Company from Vadera Manchanahalli side (SCCH-9) MVC.No.4726/2022 8 c/w MVC.No.4727/2022 came with high speed, in a rash and negligent manner and dashed against the motor cycle of the petitioner. Due to which the petitioner fell down and sustained grievous injuries all over the body and succumbed to death in the alleged RTA ? 2. Whether the petitioner is entitled for compensation? If so, what is the quantum? From whom? 3. What Order or Award? 5. In order to prove the case, the wife of deceased/petitioner No.1 in MVC No.4726/2022 has examined as PW.1 and petitioner in MVC No.4727/2022 has examined himself as PW.2. One MRD in Sparsha Hospital has examined as PW.3 in MVC No.4726/2022. One medical Record Officer has examined as PW.4 in MVC No.4727/2022. Dr.Girish.G has examined as PW.5 in MVC No.4727/2022. In all got Soundharya vs The Proprietor, Standard Information ... on 22 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121957299/ 6 marked Ex.P.1 to 44. On behalf of respondent No.2/insurance company examined its Legal Manager as RW.1 and got marked Ex.R.1 and closed their side evidence. In both the cases the learned counsel for petitioners has relied upon the citations reported in: a) 2001 ACJ 1105 b) MFA 8999/2017 ii) The PW.1 in her chief examination deposed that her deceased husband was working at Petrol bunk and earning Rs.25,000/- per month. Thus petitioners are entitled for compensation of Rs.20,15,052/- (Rs.12,917/- x 12 x 13) under the head loss of dependency. Petitioners in MVC No.4726/2022 have examined one MRD in Sparsha Hospital to prove that deceased Muniraju was admitted in their hospital as an inpatient from 06.08.2022 to 08.08.2022 and through him got marked Ex.P.30 to Ex.P.37. Further PW.1 deposed that, immediately after the accident, her deceased husband Muniraju was shifted to Vijayshree Hospital from 05.08.2022 to 06.08.2022 and on medical advice, again he was shifted to Sparsh Hospital, Bangalore. Thus, the petitioner is entitled for total compensation as follows: Soundharya vs The Proprietor, Standard Information ... on 22 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121957299/ 14
texts.arguments: The compensation claimed by the petitioners is highly exaggerated, excessive, arbitrary etc., Further contended that, there is sole negligence of deceased for his death and injuries caused to the petitioner. Further contended that, the present claim petition is liable to be dismissed for non-joinder of necessary party i.e., owner and insurer of the motor cycle bearing reg.No.KA-05-JP-3031. As per dictum of Hon'ble Supreme Court reported in AIR 2009 SC 3104 (Sarla Verma & others v/s. Delhi Transport Corporation, (SC) - "13" multiplier is applicable in present case. iv) With regard to the loss of future prospectus is concern, the Hon'ble Apex court in the decision reported in Soundharya vs The Proprietor, Standard Information ... on 22 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121957299/ 11 2017 ACJ 2700 SC ( National Insurance Co. Ltd., V/s Pranay Sethi and others.) held as under; " In case the deceased was self employed or on a fixed salary, an addition of 40% of the established income should be the warrant where the deceased was below the age of 40 year. The established income means the income minus the tax component" The learned counsel for respondent No.2 has relied upon the citation reported in MFA No.1662/2023 (MV-D) (Chandrakala and another Vs. Dilipkumar.M.A) to no interest is to be allowed on the portion of the compensation granted under the head loss of future prospects, as there would be no delay in payment of the same and since it would become due at a point of time which has not yet arisen.
